smartAgricultureSubtitle: Optimize your yields, reduce costs, and make informed decisions with our comprehensive smart farming platform.
diseaseDetectionDesc: Artificial intelligence to identify and prevent crop diseases
soilAnalysisDesc: IoT system to monitor soil quality and composition in real time
soilAnalysisPageDescription: Revolutionary IoT system to monitor soil quality and composition in real time, optimizing fertilization and irrigation of your crops with unparalleled precision.
discoverSoilAnalysisDesc: Watch this video to understand the crucial importance of soil analysis and how our technology revolutionizes precision agriculture.
innovationTechnologyDesc1: Our soil analysis system uses latest-generation IoT sensors equipped with advanced technologies: infrared spectroscopy, electrical conductivity, capacitive probes, and miniaturized chemical analyzers. This unique combination allows continuous measurement of over 15 essential parameters of your soil.
innovationTechnologyDesc2: Sensors are deployed according to an intelligent mesh adapted to the topography and variability of your plots. Each sensor transmits its data every 15 minutes via LoRaWAN to our secure cloud platform, ensuring continuous monitoring even in the most remote areas.
artificialIntelligenceDesc: Our AI algorithms analyze data in real time to detect trends, predict nutritional needs, and generate personalized recommendations for each area of your plots.
realTimeMonitoringDesc: 24/7 continuous monitoring with data transmission every 15 minutes and automatic alerts in case of critical variations.
aiRecommendationsDesc: Machine learning algorithms that adapt to the specificities of your soils to optimize fertilization and irrigation.
preciseMappingDesc: High-resolution variability maps for precision agriculture with variable input application.
durableSensorsDesc: Robust IP68 technology with 5-year lithium battery, resistant to the most extreme agricultural conditions.
dataCollectionDesc: IoT sensors continuously collect physicochemical soil data with laboratory precision directly in the field.
intelligentAnalysisDesc: Our AI processes data in real time, identifies patterns and correlations to understand the nutritional state of your soils.
recommendationsDesc: Automatic generation of personalized prescriptions to optimize the nutrition and health of your crops.
yieldIncreaseROIDesc: Precise nutrition optimization allows reaching the maximum genetic potential of your varieties. Our clients observe an average increase of 25% in yields from the first year.
costReductionROIDesc: Precise application of fertilizers according to real needs eliminates waste. Average savings of 30% on inputs with system amortization in less than 2 years.
environmentalImpactROIDesc: Significant reduction in carbon footprint through optimized nitrogen inputs and reduced nutrient leaching into groundwater.
jeanMartinTestimonial: Thanks to AgroNoya soil analysis, I increased my wheat yields by 28% while reducing my fertilizer costs by 35%. An investment paid off in 18 months!
sophieDuboisTestimonial: The precision of the recommendations allowed me to optimize the nutrition of my tomatoes. Exceptional quality and 40% water savings!
pierreLeroyTestimonial: Real-time monitoring alerts me immediately to problems. I avoided several water stresses that would have impacted my harvest.
transformAgricultureTodayDesc: Join over 2000 farmers who have already revolutionized their approach to soil management with our cutting-edge technology. Request your personalized demonstration now.
satelliteAnalysisDesc: NDVI and NDWI indices to monitor crop health from space
satelliteAnalysisPageDescription: Revolutionary spatial monitoring of your crops with NDVI and NDWI indices for ultra-precise analysis of plant health and water status from space.
spatialAgricultureInActionDesc: Discover how artificial intelligence and satellite imagery revolutionize crop monitoring and precision agriculture.
advancedSatelliteTechnologyDesc1: Our platform leverages data from Sentinel-2 (ESA), Landsat-8/9 (NASA), and MODIS satellites for global coverage with 10-meter spatial resolution. Multispectral images are acquired in 13 different spectral bands, allowing in-depth analysis of vegetation and soils.
advancedSatelliteTechnologyDesc2: Thanks to our partnership with European and American space agencies, we guarantee a pass frequency of 2-3 days over Europe, enabling near-daily monitoring of your plots. Data is processed by our AI algorithms within 2 hours of satellite acquisition.
advancedAIProcessingDesc: Our convolutional neural networks automatically analyze images to detect water stress, diseases, nutritional deficiencies, and predict yields with 95% accuracy.
ndviHealthDesc: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index to assess vegetation density and vigor.
ndwiWaterStressDesc: Normalized Difference Water Index to detect water stress and optimize irrigation.
ndreNitrogenDesc: Red Edge Normalized Difference Index to assess nitrogen status and optimize fertilization.
climaticDamageDesc: Rapid assessment after hail, frost, or drought
prescriptionMapsDesc: Variable application of inputs by zone
unlimitedCoverageDesc: Monitor all your plots without surface limits. Negligible cost compared to traditional ground monitoring methods that cost over TND 50/ha for a single visit.
centimetricPrecisionDesc: RTK geolocation of anomalies for targeted intervention. 80% reduction in prospecting time thanks to precise localization of problematic areas.
exceptionalReactivityDesc: Automatic alerts in case of detected problems. Intervention possible within 24 hours of stress appearance, multiplying treatment effectiveness by 5.
antoineLeclercTestimonial: Satellite analysis allowed me to detect a nitrogen deficiency on 15 ha before it was visible. Targeted intervention = +12% yield in this area!
marieRousseauTestimonial: Monitoring my 200 ha of orchards for less than TND 100/year. Early detection of water stress saved me 40% water!
thomasDurandTestimonial: Satellite prescription maps revolutionized my fertilization. 25% fertilizer savings with increased yields!
monitorCropsFromSpaceDesc: Join over 5000 farmers who already use our satellite technology to optimize their yields and reduce their costs. 30-day free trial on all your plots.

yourPersonalAgriculturalExpertDesc1: Our revolutionary AI assistant combines decades of agricultural expertise with the power of modern artificial intelligence. Trained on a vast agricultural knowledge base and powered by real-time data from your farm, it provides personalized and precise advice.
yourPersonalAgriculturalExpertDesc2: Whether you have questions about fertilization, irrigation, crop protection, or planting planning, your AI assistant analyzes your specific data (soil, weather, crop history) to give you recommendations tailored to your unique situation. It continuously learns from your practices and improves over time.

advancedAerialTechDesc1: Our autonomous agricultural drones revolutionize crop monitoring by providing precise and real-time data. Equipped with high-resolution multispectral cameras, they capture detailed images allowing analysis of plant health, early disease detection, and optimization of treatments.
advancedAerialTechDesc2: Each drone flight generates precise prescription maps with a resolution of 2 cm per pixel. Missions are fully automated thanks to our intelligent flight planning software that optimizes trajectories based on topography and weather conditions. Data is processed in real-time by our AI algorithms to provide you with actionable insights immediately.

precisionMeteorologyForAgricultureDesc1: Our weather forecasting system combines data from multiple sources (satellites, local weather stations, radars) with advanced AI models to provide hyper-local forecasts of exceptional accuracy. Specifically designed for agriculture, it integrates critical parameters such as evapotranspiration, soil moisture, and phytosanitary risks.
precisionMeteorologyForAgricultureDesc2: Forecasts are updated hourly with a spatial resolution of 1 km² and a temporal resolution of 15 minutes. The system generates automatic alerts for critical events (frost, hail, strong winds) and provides personalized recommendations to optimize your agricultural operations according to predicted weather conditions.

intelligentWaterManagementDesc1: Our smart irrigation system revolutionizes water management in agriculture by combining IoT sensors, artificial intelligence, and automated control. It analyzes in real time soil moisture, weather conditions, and the specific needs of each crop to trigger irrigation at the optimal time and with the exact amount of water needed.
intelligentWaterManagementDesc2: The system integrates soil moisture sensors at different depths, local weather stations, and precise weather forecasts. The AI algorithm calculates evapotranspiration in real time and automatically adjusts irrigation schedules. You can control and monitor the entire system from your smartphone or tablet, wherever you are.
